meta: Take a photo and ask AI how to fix a dripping tap or a noisy fan: many small problems at home you can fix yourself. Day 4 of the 7-day AI challenge.

muc.title: Day 4: fixing things at home
muc.text: Day four of seven: a dripping tap or a noisy fan. Many small problems you can fix yourself with your phone camera and AI.

muc.title: Photograph the problem clearly
muc.text: Take a close-up of the broken part, send it to a chatbot with a description of the noise or the leak, and ask for the usual causes.

muc.title: Photo after each step
muc.text: Ask AI to guide you step by step. After each step, send a new photo so it can check before you go on.

muc.title: Unplug it first
muc.text: Always unplug the power or close the valve before taking anything apart. Wiring inside walls or a gas tank means calling a professional.

muc.title: Day 4 task
muc.text: Photograph something at home that isn't working right, send it to a chatbot and ask for three safety checks.
